title: Equity Audit in Field Contexts
description: Artifact-specific exemplar for CAT 531 connecting equity audit in field contexts to school AI policy memo, social annotation signals, and adaptive learner-model evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze a school AI policy memo as evidence of learner judgment in CAT 531.

Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
